title: Sum of the First N Numbers
description: Return 1 + 2 + ... + n using recursion: the sum up to n is n plus the sum up to n - 1, and the sum up to 0 is 0. Watch the call stack grow to the base case and unwind.

title: Factorial with Recursion
description: Compute n! recursively: n! = n × (n - 1)!, with 0! = 1. Step through the replay to see each call wait for the one below it.

title: Array Sum with Recursion
description: Return the sum of nums without a loop: the sum from index i is nums[i] plus the sum from i + 1, and the sum past the end is 0.

title: Reverse a String
description: Return s reversed. Work recursively on a list of its characters: swap the outermost pair, then reverse what lies between them.

sourceTitle: Check if String is Palindrome or Not
title: Palindrome String with Recursion
description: Return whether s reads the same in both directions, comparing characters exactly (case matters). A string is a palindrome if its ends match and its middle is a palindrome.

examples.explanation: M and m are different characters.

sourceTitle: Check if a Number is Prime or Not
title: Prime Check with Recursion
description: Return whether n is prime by trying divisors recursively: check d, and if it does not divide n, check d + 1, stopping once d × d exceeds n.

title: Reverse an Array with Recursion
description: Reverse nums in place using recursion on two indices, then return it.

sourceTitle: Sum of Digits in a Given Number
title: Sum of Digits
description: Return the sum of the decimal digits of a non-negative integer n, recursively: the last digit plus the digit sum of n // 10.

title: Fibonacci Number
description: F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1 and F(n) = F(n - 1) + F(n - 2). Return F(n). The plain recursion repeats a lot of work; the replay makes the repeated calls easy to spot.

title: Selection Sort
description: Sort nums in ascending order with selection sort: for each position, find the smallest remaining value and swap it into place. Return the sorted array.

title: Bubble Sort
description: Sort nums in ascending order with bubble sort: repeatedly swap neighbours that are out of order, and stop early once a full pass makes no swaps.

examples.explanation: Already sorted: one pass and done.

title: Insertion Sort
description: Sort nums in ascending order with insertion sort: grow a sorted prefix by sliding each new value left until it sits in order.

title: Merge Sort
description: Sort nums in ascending order with merge sort: split the range in half, sort each half recursively, then merge the two sorted halves.
referenceCode:
def merge_sort(nums):
    def sort(low, high):
        if low >= high:
            return
        mid = (low + high) // 2
        sort(low, mid)
        sort(mid + 1, high)
        merged = []
        left, right = low, mid + 1
        while left <= mid and right <= high:
            if nums[left] <= nums[right]:
                merged.append(nums[left])
                left += 1
            else:
                merged.append(nums[right])
                right += 1
        merged.extend(nums[left:mid + 1])
        merged.extend(nums[right:high + 1])
        nums[low:high + 1] = merged

    sort(0, len(nums) - 1)
    return nums

title: Quick Sort
description: Sort nums in ascending order with quick sort: pick the first value of the range as the pivot, move smaller values to its left and larger ones to its right, then sort both sides recursively.
